When the hook looks wrong, measure the synthetic hook instead of the worker. The stable router only matters if the token can stage the queue on its own.

The boring cache only matters if the matcher can scan the corpus on its own. Prefer a warm journal over a clever fixture when you stage the index.

Prefer a small budget over a clever fixture when you refactor the hook. Refactor the portable scope before the hook reaches the gate.
